code.provenance_note: Prod trained from <run>/code_snapshot (a copy of the main working tree on 2026-10-07 00:27; no git SHA recorded). The snapshot's training path (training, data, qwen_vision, acceleration, preprocessing, full10) is byte-identical to 07d6eb7. evaluation.py and modeling.py also carry the eval-only --image-size override, committed later in 879eebe. Later main adds opt-in rally features (--keep-epoch-checkpoints, covered_event_ids) that are inactive for this recipe.

pythonpath_overlays.name: torchao
pythonpath_overlays.note: Prod used this cu128 build of torchao on top of torch 2.11.0+cu130. It imports cleanly there, and the recipe only uses its tensorwise Float8Linear path, which runs on torch._scaled_mm. Its cu128 C++ kernels are not used, and they are untested on cu130. The wheel's RECORD file hashes match the overlay exactly.

env.note: Training env lock. The pipeline's inference env (pipeline/environment.yml, conda name skyball-prod-infer, adds open_clip 3.3.0) is separate; prod gameplay trained in a skyball-prod-infer env with these package versions.

fetch.note: Only the vision tower is used: config.json, the index, and outside.safetensors (2.9 GB, holds every model.visual.* tensor). Lands in $HF_HOME/hub; SKYBALL_QWEN_SNAPSHOT overrides the location.

19 uncompressed zips (~10 GB each, 154 GiB), 1,020,504 frames. Staged under $SKYBALL_STAGING_ROOT (default <data_root>/../unified_staging), then unzipped with -n into $SKYBALL_DATA_ROOT/derived/gameplay.
Published FP32 pipeline bundle, copied to $SKYBALL_REPRO_CACHE/<local> (default ~/.cache/skyball_repro). --export uses it as the template for artifact.json and qwen_vision_config.json.

hardware.note: Prod: 2026-10-07 00:27 to 06:03, ~0.30 s/iteration, 14,928 iterations per epoch per GPU (per-GPU batch 4) plus FP32 validation each epoch.

train.note: Hyperparameters live only in config/indoor_canonical.json (its args are the exact flags prod ran with); tests/test_reproduce.py checks that this recipe and that config agree.

select.note: Keep the epoch with the highest clean val48 F1 at threshold 0.5; the trainer saves it as best_<tag>.pth.tar.

tolerance.note: Prod ran once, so seed-to-seed noise is unmeasured (FP8 + torch.compile + NCCL are not bitwise deterministic). 0.005 is about 2.5 binomial standard errors of F1 on 11,869 positives, and larger than the epoch 3-4 gap (0.0010) and the batch 8 vs 16 pilot gap (0.0023). Epochs 3 and 4 are within 0.001, so a different selected epoch is reported as INFO, not FAIL.

rescore.note: Standalone FP32 re-score of the selected checkpoint on the val split (clean val48); must match the selected epoch's in-training F1 within the same tolerance.
